name: cat-yoink
description: Watches a Discord channel for Cat Bot spawns and lets you yoink them from VS Code.

commands.title: Cat Yoink: Log In To Discord

catYoink.browserPath.description: Path to Edge or Chrome. Leave empty to auto-detect.

catYoink.botName.description: Display name of the bot that posts cats.

catYoink.triggerText.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the bot message that means a cat appeared.

catYoink.caughtText.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the bot message that means somebody caught the cat. The default covers Cat Bot's spellings (caught, cought, coought...).

catYoink.replyText.description: Message sent to the channel when you press Yoink.

catYoink.rainStartText.default: cat rain was started|started a short rain|\brain will start\b|\brain extended\b
catYoink.rainStartText.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against Cat Bot's messages that means a cat rain started. The default covers /rain ("5m cat rain was started by..."), Catnip ("Catnip started a short rain!"), rain boosts ("A 5m rain will start!") and "RAIN EXTENDED".

catYoink.rainEndText.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against Cat Bot's messages that means the cat rain is over.

catYoink.autoStart.description: Open Cat Yoink and start watching every time VS Code starts (needs a channel link).

catYoink.minimizeWithVSCode.description: Windows: hide the cat window while its VS Code window is minimized, and show it again when VS Code is restored. Cats that appear meanwhile wait until then.

catYoink.checkForUpdates.description: Once a day, check GitHub for a newer Cat Yoink release and offer its download page.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: node scripts/fetch-webview2.js && node scripts/build-host.js && npm run compile
